outcome: Side effects of COVID-19 vaccination (e.g., mild fever)
cohort: The study included 247 women who had received the COVID-19 vaccine, categorized into those vaccinated preconceptionally (n=122) and those vaccinated antenatally (n=125).
finding: Women vaccinated during pregnancy had a significant decrease in mean gestational age at delivery and a higher incidence of preterm birth compared to those vaccinated preconceptionally.
